orchestrationHints: Use before post-due-diligence so compile, targeted tests, and broad validation converge before extra repo-specific checks.
Always establish the compile/build step first, even if the repo later turns out to have no separate compile command.
Keep each loop iteration tied to one hypothesis and one category of failure.
When invoked from fix-jira-issue or fix-feature, finishing this loop is not session completion — the orchestrator continues into PR open and review polling.

metadata.templateDescription: Run a strict build-then-test fix loop that separates compile failures from logic failures, requires explicit root-cause analysis, and ends with broader validation plus prevention notes.
